arxiv-1408-2073.title: The Extended Thermodynamic Properties
arxiv-1408-2073.creator: of
arxiv-1408-2073.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by of. We investigate the extended thermodynamic properties of higher-dimensional Taub-NUT/Bolt-AdS spaces where a cosmological constant is treated as a pressure. We find a general form for thermodynamic volumes of Taub-NUT/Bolt-AdS black holes for arbitrary dimensions. Interestingly, it is found that the Taub-NUT-AdS metric has a thermodynamically stable range when the total number of dimensions is a multiple of 4 (4, 8, 12, …). We also explore their phase structure and find the first order phase transition holds for higher-dimensional cases.

arxiv-2106-00468.title: Flat-band ferromagnetism and spin waves in the Haldane-Hubbard model
arxiv-2106-00468.creator: Leonardo S. G. Leite and R. L. Doretto
arxiv-2106-00468.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Leonardo S. G. Leite and R. L. Doretto. We study the flat-band ferromagnetic phase of the Haldane-Hubbard model on a honeycomb lattice within a bosonization scheme for flat-band Chern insulators, focusing on the calculation of the spin-wave excitation spectrum. We consider the Haldane-Hubbard model with the noninteracting lower bands in a nearly-flat band limit, previously determined for the spinless model, and at 1 / 4 1/4 -filling of its corresponding noninteracting limit.

arxiv-2206-10035.title: On deformations of isolated singularity functions Thanks: The first author was supported by the Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico (CNPq), Brazil.
arxiv-2206-10035.creator: Aurélio Menegon, Miriam da Silva Pereira
arxiv-2206-10035.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Aurélio Menegon, Miriam da Silva Pereira. We study multi-parameters deformations of isolated singularity function-germs on either a subanalytic set or a complex analytic spaces. We prove that if such a deformation has no coalescing of singular points, then it has constant topological type. This extends some classical results due to Lê & Ramanujam (1976) and Parusiński (1999), as well as a recent result due to Jesus-Almeida and the first author.

arxiv-2505-10365.creator: Yunhui He 1,2, Yuechun Jiao 1,2, Jianming Zhao 1,2, Weibin Li 3
arxiv-2505-10365.description: Abstract Periodically driven Floquet quantum systems hold great promise for engineering exotic quantum phases and matter, but are often limited by rapid thermalization.
